digest.component_or_area: LLM runner and CI workflow integration
propositions: Weekly LLM jobs (external-integration and prompt-eval) make real billable API calls but produce no retrievable record of token usage
Per-call usage is computed in PydanticAIRunner.run but is lost because logs are suppressed by NullHandler and eval/pytest layers drop the _usage field
A new usage_log module must expose record(usage, op) and summarize(path) functions to capture JSONL token records and generate Markdown summaries
Both workflows must set REBAR_USAGE_LOG environment variable, append summarize output to job summary, and upload raw JSONL artifact for durability
Implementation must remain opt-in via env var and must not alter runner behavior or existing test paths when the env var is unset
